title: Signal fusion and scope-sprint bridge for enterprise requests
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable process (canvas + scoring heuristic + sprint-bridge) for aggregating Sales/CS enterprise feature asks, producing a 1-page synthesis and a recommended engineering sprint scope. This ticket defines the artifacts, decision rules, and handoff checklist; it is intended to reduce time-to-first-scope from days to <48 hours for high-priority accounts while preserving technical feasibility checks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Template created: synthesis canvas, prioritized impact/cost rubric, and sprint-bridge checklist exist in Confluence; 2) Pilot: 3 real Sales/CS requests processed through the flow with documented outcomes; 3) Handoff: engineering receives a single-page scope brief + required artifacts (mock API contract, security notes, mock data) within 48 hours; 4) Stakeholder feedback: CS and 2 PM reviewers approve the format and scoring; 5) Metrics: median time-to-scope <= 48h in pilot, customer_impact annotated for each request.
notes: Trade-offs: keep the canvas intentionally minimal to avoid back-and-forth with Sales. We accept coarser cost estimates in exchange for faster alignment. If a request scores above threshold for complexity, route to 'deep-scope' path (separate kickoff). Consider eventual automation: Slack intake + form -> prefilled canvas. Dependencies on ENG capacity and security review for private deployments.

implementation_risks: Risk of missing technical constraints when Sales provides optimistic requirements; mitigate with mandatory small feasibility checklist. Risk of over-indexing on single-customer asks; mitigate with cohorting guideline in template.
communication_plan: Announce the new flow in weekly CS sync, host a 20min walk-through, publish one-pager in Sales playbook and link in shared Slack channel. Track adoption in the intake dashboard.
